sites.name: Sly Guard Cabin
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: The Sly Guard Cabin is less remote than other cabins on the Eldorado National forest and is a great choice for families with children. Sly Guard provides the cabin in the woods experience with the convenience of modern amenities. The cabin is near Sly Park Reservoir, also called Jenkinson Lake,…
sites.directions: From Highway 50, take the Sly Park exit at Pollock Pines, turn right on Sly Park road for 6 miles. Check in is done in person at the Placerville Ranger Station 4260 Eight Mile Rd., Camino Ca. 95709.
